workflow_runs.display_title: Fix: Improve text encoding for shell output in VSCode preview (#6178)

head_commit.message:
fix: improve text encoding for shell output in VSCode preview (#6178)

   Replace String::from_utf8_lossy() with intelligent encoding detection
   in StreamOutput::from_utf8_lossy() to fix garbled text in VSCode shell
   preview when running commands with non-ASCII characters in Windows/WSL.

   The new bytes_to_string_smart() function tries multiple encoding strategies:
   1. UTF-8 (fast path for valid UTF-8)
   2. Windows-1252 (common in Windows environments)
   3. Latin-1 (fallback for extended ASCII)
   4. Lossy UTF-8 (final fallback)

head_commit.message:
fix: improve text encoding for shell output in VSCode preview (#6178)

   Replace String::from_utf8_lossy() with intelligent encoding detection
   in StreamOutput::from_utf8_lossy() to fix garbled text in VSCode shell
   preview when running commands with non-ASCII characters in Windows/WSL.

   The new bytes_to_string_smart() function tries multiple encoding strategies:
   1. UTF-8 (fast path for valid UTF-8)
   2. Windows-1252 (common in Windows environments)
   3. Latin-1 (fallback for extended ASCII)
   4. Lossy UTF-8 (final fallback)
